scenario: Mixed-type interval `contains` per LINT.3.2.2 — both intervals must have matching element types. `Int`-interval `contains` `Date`-interval rejects with DS_VALIDATE_TYPE_MISMATCH.
rules_ds:
schema Check scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    i_start: Int mutable
    i_end: Int mutable
    date_val: Date mutable

rule r:
    Check c where (c.i_start..c.i_end) contains (c.date_val..c.date_val)
->
    log info "x"
